summary: Ruanyun Edai Technology (NASDAQ: RYET) filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 10, 2026 press release announcing a non-binding memorandum of understanding with Chongqing Anyi Automobile Technical Service and Intersect Holding to explore an automotive and new energy vehicle institute in Saudi Arabia. No stake, price, or consideration is disclosed; the MOU contemplates cooperation with Umm Al-Qura University on four-year undergraduate and two-year applied diploma programs. This is a routine business-development announcement, not a special situation. Watch for definitive agreements, capital commitments, and any Saudi regulatory or licensing approvals; no arbitrage angle exists.
